reason: I have refused third-party cloud tools for years because storing confidential client PAN and ITR data on external systems terrifies me. I will not pay for an annual subscription until I personally test the free pilot and verify that connecting Google Drive cannot touch any of our existing private archives.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: Technical proof on the Google OAuth consent screen confirming strict drive.file scope isolation with zero access to existing drive folders, verified during a free trial.
